entry.summary:
Variables are one of the first core concepts in Python. Understanding how they work makes writing and reading code much easier. A variable is like a named box that holds a value. You create a variable by giving it a name and assigning a value with the = sign. age = 25 name = "Alex" price = 9.99 is_student = True
